1→# Design Feedback — Resume Scoring Tool Landing Page
     2→
     3→## The Problem
     4→
     5→Both the resume tool and the B-Roll guide page were clearly built by an LLM because they share the exact same default AI design stack. Anyone who's seen a few AI-generated sites will clock it instantly. Here's what's identical:
     6→
     7→---
     8→
     9→## Shared AI Tells (What to Fix)
    10→
    11→### 1. Font Stack — THE biggest tell
    12→Both pages use the exact same combo:
    13→- **DM Sans** for body/UI text
    14→- **Instrument Serif** (italic) for the accent word ("Unfiltered" / "Custom Visuals")
    15→- **DM Mono** for small labels
    16→
    17→This is the #1 default font combo that Claude/ChatGPT reach for when building dark premium-looking sites. It's become the "tell me you used AI without telling me" of web design.
    18→
    19→**Fix:** Replace with any of these combos:
    20→- Headings: `"Suisse Intl", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, sans-serif` → clean, Swiss, financial
    21→- Accent/italic: `"Playfair Display"` or `"Cormorant Garamond"` instead of Instrument Serif
    22→- Body: `"IBM Plex Sans"` or `"Söhne"` or just `"Helvetica Neue"` instead of DM Sans
    23→- Mono: `"JetBrains Mono"` or `"SF Mono"` instead of DM Mono
    24→
    25→### 2. The Italic Serif Accent Word
    26→Using one gold/blue italic serif word inside a sans-serif heading ("Built for IB recruiting. *Unfiltered.*") is an AI layout cliche at this point. Every AI-generated landing page does this.
    27→
    28→**Fix:** Either:
    29→- Make the entire heading serif (not just one word)
    30→- Use weight contrast instead of font contrast (e.g., light weight + bold weight, same font)
    31→- If keeping the accent word, use a different serif than Instrument Serif and consider using color alone (no italic) to differentiate
    32→
    33→### 3. Border Radius
    34→Both pages use `8px` and `10px` border-radius — the AI default. Real premium/financial sites use sharper corners.
    35→
    36→**Fix:**
    37→- Cards/containers: `4px` max, or `2px` for that Bloomberg feel
    38→- Buttons: `4px` or `2px` (not `8px`)
    39→- Input fields: `2px` or `0px` (sharp)
    40→
    41→### 4. Background Color
    42→Both use nearly identical dark navy/charcoal backgrounds (`rgb(10,12,18)` on B-Roll, similar near-black on resume tool). This specific shade of dark is the AI default "dark mode."
    43→
    44→**Fix:**
    45→- Go true black: `#000000` or `#050505` — more confident, less "themed"
    46→- Or go slightly warm: `#0C0A09` (warm black) instead of blue-tinted dark
    47→- Avoid the navy-tinted dark that AI defaults to
    48→
    49→### 5. Text Color / Opacity Pattern
    50→Both use the same muted gray text (`rgb(184,191,206)` — a blue-gray) for body copy. This is the AI default "dark mode readable text."
    51→
    52→**Fix:**
    53→- Use a warmer gray: `#A8A29E` (stone) or `#9CA3AF` (neutral gray) instead of blue-gray
    54→- Or go higher contrast: `#D4D4D4` for body text — more Bloomberg terminal, less AI template
    55→
    56→### 6. Spacing Uniformity
    57→AI-generated pages have eerily perfect, uniform spacing. Everything is multiples of 8px with identical gaps.
    58→
    59→**Fix:**
    60→- Introduce slight asymmetry — e.g., more padding on left than right in the hero
    61→- Vary vertical spacing (don't make every section gap identical)
    62→- Let the form card sit slightly higher or lower than perfectly centered
    63→
    64→### 7. The "Continue →" Button
    65→Gold/amber filled button with an arrow is a very common AI premium template pattern.
    66→
    67→**Fix:**
    68→- Consider an outlined/ghost button instead (border only, no fill)
    69→- Or make it white text on transparent with a subtle border
    70→- Remove the arrow `→` — it's an AI cliche. Just say "Continue" or "Submit"
    71→
    72→---
    73→
    74→## Quick Wins (Copy-Paste CSS Overrides)
    75→
    76→```css
    77→/* FONTS — swap the AI defaults */
    78→@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap');
    79→
    80→/* Replace DM Sans everywhere */
    81→body, p, span, label, input {
    82→  font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
    83→  letter-spacing: -0.01em; /* tighter than AI default */
    84→}
    85→
    86→/* Replace Instrument Serif accent */
    87→.accent-text, .italic-highlight {
    88→  font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif;
    89→}
    90→
    91→/* Replace DM Mono */
    92→code, .mono, .stat-label {
    93→  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", monospace;
    94→}
    95→
    96→/* BORDER RADIUS — sharpen everything */
    97→.card, .form-container {
    98→  border-radius: 3px; /* was 8-10px */
    99→}
   100→
   101→button, input {
   102→  border-radius: 2px; /* was 8px */
   103→}
   104→
   105→/* BACKGROUND — true black, not navy */
   106→body, .hero {
   107→  background-color: #050505; /* was ~rgb(10,12,18) navy */
   108→}
   109→
   110→/* TEXT COLOR — warmer, not blue-gray */
   111→body, p {
   112→  color: #B5B0A8; /* warm stone instead of blue-gray */
   113→}
   114→
   115→h1, h2, .heading {
   116→  color: #EDEDED; /* slightly off-white */
   117→}
   118→
   119→/* BUTTON — less AI, more minimal */
   120→.cta-button {
   121→  background: transparent;

+- **"Unfiltered" accent:** `"Cormorant Garamond"` instead of Instrument Serif

-- Body: `"IBM Plex Sans"` or `"Söhne"` or just `"Helvetica Neue"` instead of DM Sans

+Add tighter letter-spacing (`-0.01em`) on body text — AI defaults leave it too loose.
-Using one gold/blue italic serif word inside a sans-serif heading ("Built for IB recruiting. *Unfiltered.*") is an AI layout cliche at this point. Every AI-generated landing page does this.
-- Make the entire heading serif (not just one word)
-- Use weight contrast instead of font contrast (e.g., light weight + bold weight, same font)
-- If keeping the accent word, use a different serif than Instrument Serif and consider using color alone (no italic) to differentiate
+"Built for IB recruiting. *Unfiltered.*" — one gold italic serif word inside a sans-serif heading is an AI layout cliche now. Two options:
-Both pages use `8px` and `10px` border-radius — the AI default. Real premium/financial sites use sharper corners.
+- **Option A:** Make the full heading serif. "Built for IB recruiting" in Cormorant Garamond regular, "Unfiltered" in Cormorant Garamond italic + gold color. Same font family, just style shift.
+- **Option B:** Keep it sans-serif but use weight contrast. "Built for IB recruiting." in light weight, "Unfiltered." in bold + gold. No font switch at all.

-Both use nearly identical dark navy/charcoal backgrounds (`rgb(10,12,18)` on B-Roll, similar near-black on resume tool). This specific shade of dark is the AI default "dark mode."

+This alone makes a huge difference — gives it that Bloomberg/terminal sharpness.
-- Use a warmer gray: `#A8A29E` (stone) or `#9CA3AF` (neutral gray) instead of blue-gray
-- Or go higher contrast: `#D4D4D4` for body text — more Bloomberg terminal, less AI template

# PDF Processing Guide

## Overview

This guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see REFERENCE.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read FORMS.md and follow its instructions.

## Quick Start

```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Read a PDF
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

# Extract text
text = ""
for page in reader.pages:
    text += page.extract_text()
```

## Python Libraries

### pypdf - Basic Operations

#### Merge PDFs
```python
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader

writer = PdfWriter()
for pdf_file in ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.pdf", "doc3.pdf"]:
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

with open("merged.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

#### Split PDF
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(page)
    with open(f"page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as output:
        writer.write(output)
```

#### Extract Metadata
```python
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
meta = reader.metadata
print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
print(f"Subject: {meta.subject}")
print(f"Creator: {meta.creator}")
```

#### Rotate Pages
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

page = reader.pages[0]
page.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
writer.add_page(page)

with open("rotated.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction

#### Extract Text with Layout
```python
import pdfplumber

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for page in pdf.pages:
        text = page.extract_text()
        print(text)
```

#### Extract Tables
```python
with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for j, table in enumerate(tables):
            print(f"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:")
            for row in table:
                print(row)
```

#### Advanced Table Extraction
```python
import pandas as pd

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    all_tables = []
    for page in pdf.pages:
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for table in tables:
            if table:  # Check if table is not empty
                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])
                all_tables.append(df)

# Combine all tables
if all_tables:
    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)
    combined_df.to_excel("extracted_tables.xlsx", index=False)
```

### reportlab - Create PDFs

#### Basic PDF Creation
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

c = canvas.Canvas("hello.pdf", pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Add text
c.drawString(100, height - 100, "Hello World!")
c.drawString(100, height - 120, "This is a PDF created with reportlab")

# Add a line
c.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)

# Save
c.save()
```

#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

doc = SimpleDocTemplate("report.pdf", pagesize=letter)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
story = []

# Add content
title = Paragraph("Report Title", styles['Title'])
story.append(title)
story.append(Spacer(1, 12))

body = Paragraph("This is the body of the report. " * 20, styles['Normal'])
story.append(body)
story.append(PageBreak())

# Page 2
story.append(Paragraph("Page 2", styles['Heading1']))
story.append(Paragraph("Content for page 2", styles['Normal']))

# Build PDF
doc.build(story)
```

#### Subscripts and Superscripts

**IMPORTANT**: Never use Unicode subscript/superscript characters (₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉, ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) in ReportLab PDFs. The built-in fonts do not include these glyphs, causing them to render as solid black boxes.

Instead, use ReportLab's XML markup tags in Paragraph objects:
```python
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

# Subscripts: use <sub> tag
chemical = Paragraph("H<sub>2</sub>O", styles['Normal'])

# Superscripts: use <super> tag
squared = Paragraph("x<super>2</super> + y<super>2</super>", styles['Normal'])
```

For canvas-drawn text (not Paragraph objects), manually adjust font the size and position rather than using Unicode subscripts/superscripts.

## Command-Line Tools

### pdftotext (poppler-utils)
```bash
# Extract text
pdftotext input.pdf output.txt

# Extract text preserving layout
pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt

# Extract specific pages
pdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5
```

### qpdf
```bash
# Merge PDFs
qpdf --empty --pages file1.pdf file2.pdf -- merged.pdf

# Split pages
qpdf input.pdf --pages . 1-5 -- pages1-5.pdf
qpdf input.pdf --pages . 6-10 -- pages6-10.pdf

# Rotate pages
qpdf input.pdf output.pdf --rotate=+90:1  # Rotate page 1 by 90 degrees

# Remove password
qpdf --password=mypassword --decrypt encrypted.pdf decrypted.pdf
```

### pdftk (if available)
```bash
# Merge
pdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf

# Split
pdftk input.pdf burst

# Rotate
pdftk input.pdf rotate 1east output rotated.pdf
```

## Common Tasks

### Extract Text from Scanned PDFs
```python
# Requires: pip install pytesseract pdf2image
import pytesseract
from pdf2image import convert_from_path

# Convert PDF to images
images = convert_from_path('scanned.pdf')

# OCR each page
text = ""
for i, image in enumerate(images):
    text += f"Page {i+1}:\n"
    text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
    text += "\n\n"

print(text)
```

### Add Watermark
```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Create watermark (or load existing)
watermark = PdfReader("watermark.pdf").pages[0]

# Apply to all pages
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

for page in reader.pages:
    page.merge_page(watermark)
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("watermarked.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### Extract Images
```bash
# Using pdfimages (poppler-utils)
pdfimages -j input.pdf output_prefix

# This extracts all images as output_prefix-000.jpg, output_prefix-001.jpg, etc.
```

### Password Protection
```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

# Add password
writer.encrypt("userpassword", "ownerpassword")

with open("encrypted.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

## Quick Reference

| Task | Best Tool | Command/Code |
|------|-----------|--------------|
| Merge PDFs | pypdf | `writer.add_page(page)` |
| Split PDFs | pypdf | One page per file |
| Extract text | pdfplumber | `page.extract_text()` |
| Extract tables | pdfplumber | `page.extract_tables()` |
| Create PDFs | reportlab | Canvas or Platypus |
| Command line merge | qpdf | `qpdf --empty --pages ...` |
| OCR scanned PDFs | pytesseract | Convert to image first |
| Fill PDF forms | pdf-lib or pypdf (see FORMS.md) | See FORMS.md |

## Next Steps

- For advanced pypdfium2 usage, see REFERENCE.md
- For JavaScript libraries (pdf-lib), see REFERENCE.md
- If you need to fill out a PDF form, follow the instructions in FORMS.md
- For troubleshooting guides, see REFERENCE.md

Open it in your browser and start playing with the controls to see how different font/color/style combinations look on the actual page layouts.

message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Daniel (rareliquid team) is building a comprehensive interactive design system tool for an IB Resume scoring website (https://ib-resume-os-yd67.vercel.app/) built by colleague Zygimantas. The core requirements evolved through multiple messages:
   
   - **Interactive mockup with tabs**: All pages of the resume tool (Landing, Upload, About You, Target Banks, Results) as separate tabs with a floating control panel to change design elements (fonts, colors, radius, etc.) in real-time
   - **Design Compare as first tab**: The original 20-section, 160-card static comparison document should be the FIRST tab, but with **clickable cards** — clicking a card applies that style globally across all other page tabs AND syncs with the floating toolbar
   - **Global Colors section**: At the bottom of the Design Compare tab, color pickers for primary, secondary, tertiary, and other colors that apply to various page elements
   - **Save/Export button**: At the very bottom, a save button that downloads both the styled HTML file AND a manifest.json file containing all chosen design parameters — intended for feeding to an LLM to reconstruct the site with those specific parameters
   - **Visual perfection**: "keep iterating until perfection for every single aspect of the page" — screenshot every tab, compare with original, fix all discrepancies
   - **Fix style breakage**: User reported "lots of the style things break" when using the controls

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - CSS Custom Properties (variables) for theming — all design tokens as `--variable-name`
   - Bidirectional sync between Design Compare card clicks and floating panel dropdowns
   - Conic-gradient for score circles with inner cutout technique
   - Google Fonts loading (14+ font families: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Libre Baskerville, Lora, DM Sans, IBM Plex Sans, Space Grotesk, Inter, DM Mono, JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, Fira Code, Inconsolata, Instrument Serif)
   - DataTransfer API + base64 encoding for programmatic PDF upload to browser
   - Python script-based HTML generation to handle large file sizes without hitting token limits

<style>
:root {

  --color-orange: #F39C12;
  --border-radius: 6px;
  --btn-radius: 6px;
  --input-radius: 6px;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:var(--bg-body);color:var(--text-primary);font-family:var(--body-font);line-height:1.6}

/* ─── TAB NAV ─── */
.tab-nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;display:flex;gap:1px;background:rgba(10,10,10,0.97);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);padding:0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.tab-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{height:0}
.tab-btn{padding:12px 18px;background:transparent;border:none;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;color:var(--text-secondary);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.04em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--accent-gold);border-bottom-color:var(--accent-gold);background:rgba(201,169,110,0.06)}
.tab-btn:hover:not(.active){color:#ccc}
.tab-content{display:none;padding:0}
.tab-content.active{display:block}

/* ─── FLOATING CONTROL PANEL ─── */
.ctrl-panel{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;width:300px;max-height:80vh;background:rgba(20,20,20,0.97);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-radius:8px;z-index:500;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;overflow:hidden;transition:all .3s}
.ctrl-panel.collapsed{max-height:42px}
.ctrl-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);cursor:move;user-select:none}
.ctrl-header h3{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#aaa;font-weight:600}
.ctrl-header button{background:none;border:none;color:#888;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;padding:0 4px}
.ctrl-body{padding:8px 12px;overflow-y:auto;max-height:calc(80vh - 42px)}
.ctrl-group{margin-bottom:10px}
.ctrl-group label{display:block;font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;color:#666;margin-bottom:3px;font-weight:600}
.ctrl-group select{width:100%;background:#1a1a1a;color:#ccc;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-radius:4px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;outline:none}
.ctrl-group select:focus{border-color:var(--accent-gold)}
.ctrl-divider{border:none;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);margin:10px 0}
.btn-reset{width:100%;padding:8px;background:rgba(231,76,60,0.12);color:#E74C3C;border:1px solid rgba(231,76,60,0.2);border-radius:4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif}
.btn-reset:hover{background:rgba(231,76,60,0.2)}

/* ─── DESIGN COMPARE TAB ─── */
.dc-wrap{padding:40px 24px 100px;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto}
.dc-title{font-size:28px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-0.02em;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif}
.dc-sub{font-size:13px;color:#666;margin-bottom:50px;line-height:1.6}
.dc-section{margin-bottom:60px}
.dc-section-title{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.14em;color:#D4A853;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:600;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif}
.dc-note{font-size:11px;color:#555;margin-bottom:12px;font-style:italic}
.dc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:12px}
.dc-card{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;position:relative}
.dc-card:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.dc-card.selected{border-color:var(--accent-gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent-gold),0 0 20px rgba(201,169,110,0.15)}
.dc-card.selected::after{content:'✓';position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;width:18px;height:18px;background:var(--accent-gold);color:#000;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700}
.dc-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
.dc-label span{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#aaa}
.dc-tag{font-size:7px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:2px;font-weight:700}
.dc-tag-cur{background:rgba(255,80,80,0.12);color:#ff6b6b}
.dc-tag-alt{background:rgba(80,200,120,0.1);color:#50c878}
.dc-preview{padding:16px 12px;min-height:60px}
.dc-meta{padding:4px 10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.015)}
.dc-meta code{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:8px;color:#444;line-height:1.5}
.dc-part-divider{margin:70px 0 50px;text-align:center}
.dc-part-divider h2{font-size:18px;color:#fff;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:4px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif}
.dc-part-divider p{font-size:11px;color:#555}
.dc-part-divider .bar{width:40px;height:1px;background:#D4A853;margin:12px auto 0}

  <style>
    :root {
      --heading-font: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      --body-font: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      --mono-font: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      --accent-font: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      --accent-gold: #C9A96E;
      --bg-body: #0A0A0A;
      --bg-card: #141312;
      --text-primary: #F5F5F5;
      --text-secondary: #888888;
      --color-green: #2ECC71;
      --color-red: #E74C3C;
      --color-orange: #F39C12;
      --border-radius: 6px;
      --btn-radius: 6px;
      --input-radius: 6px;
    }
    * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
    body { background:var(--bg-body); color:var(--text-primary); font-family:var(--body-font); line-height:1.6; }

    /* TAB NAV */
    .tab-nav { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:100; display:flex; gap:1px; background:rgba(10,10,10,0.97); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); padding:0 8px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); overflow-x:auto; }
    .tab-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { height:0; }
    .tab-btn { padding:12px 18px; background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; color:var(--text-secondary); font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.05em; white-space:nowrap; transition:all 0.2s ease; }
    .tab-btn:hover { color:var(--text-primary); }
    .tab-btn.active { color:var(--text-primary); border-bottom-color:var(--accent-gold); }
    .tab-content { display:none; animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease; }
    .tab-content.active { display:block; }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity:0; } to { opacity:1; } }

    /* DC LAYOUT */
    .dc-split { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 400px; gap:40px; max-width:1600px; margin:0 auto; padding:40px; }
    .dc-left { flex:1; }
    .dc-right { position:sticky; top:80px; height:max-content; max-height:calc(100vh - 100px); overflow-y:auto; background:var(--bg-card); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:var(--border-radius); padding:20px; }
    .dc-right::-webkit-scrollbar { width:4px; }
    .dc-right::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:2px; }
    .dc-section { margin-bottom:50px; }
    .dc-section-title { font-family:var(--heading-font); font-size:18px; font-weight:500; color:var(--text-primary); margin-bottom:16px; padding-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }
    .dc-section-subtitle { font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom:20px; display:block; }
    .dc-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap:12px; }
    .dc-card { background:var(--bg-card); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:var(--border-radius); padding:14px; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s ease; position:relative; }
    .dc-card:hover { border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
    .dc-card.selected { border-color:var(--accent-gold); background:rgba(201,169,110,0.08); }
    .dc-label { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:10px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; color:var(--text-secondary); }
    .dc-label span:first-child { flex:1; }
    .dc-tag { display:inline-block; padding:2px 6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:3px; font-size:9px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-left:8px; }
    .dc-tag-cur { background:var(--accent-gold); color:#111; }
    .dc-tag-alt { background:rgba(101,148,245,0.2); color:#6594F5; }
    .dc-preview { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius:var(--border-radius); padding:12px; margin-bottom:10px; min-height:60px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
    .dc-meta { font-size:10px; color:var(--text-secondary); }
    .dc-meta code { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding:2px 4px; border-radius:3px; font-family:var(--mono-font); display:block; word-break:break-all; }

    /* PAGE STYLES */
    .page-container { max-width:1200px; margin:0 auto; padding:60px 40px; }
    .bank-ticker { overflow:hidden; padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); margin-bottom:60px; }
    .bank-ticker-text { font-family:var(--body-font); font-size:11px; font-weight:500; color:var(--text-secondary); letter-spacing:0.2em; white-space:nowrap; }
    .hero-section { display:flex; gap:60px; align-items:flex-start; }
    .hero-left { flex:1; }
    .hero-badge { font-size:11px; color:var(--text-secondary); letter-spacing:0.15em; margin-bottom:20px; }
    .hero-title { font-family:var(--heading-font); font-size:52px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.15; color:var(--text-primary); margin-bottom:8px; }
    .hero-subtitle { font-family:var(--accent-font); font-size:52px; font-style:italic; color:var(--accent-gold); margin-bottom:30px; }
    .hero-description { font-family:var(--body-font); font-size:14px; color:var(--text-secondary); max-width:400px; line-height:1.7; }
    .hero-stats { display:flex; gap:40px; margin-top:40px; }
    .hero-stat-value { font-family:var(--mono-font); font-size:28px; color:var(--text-primary); }
    .hero-stat-label { font-size:10px; color:var(--text-secondary); letter-spacing:0.1em; margin-top:4px; }
    .form-card { width:400px; background:var(--bg-card); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:var(--border-radius); padding:40px; }
    .form-label { display:block; font-size:10px; color:var(--text-secondary); letter-spacing:0.1em; margin-bottom:6px; }
    .form-field { background:#1a1a1a; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:var(--input-radius); padding:12px 14px; color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:14px; margin-bottom:16px; width:100%; }
    .form-button { background:var(--accent-gold); color:#111; text-align:center; padding:14px; border-radius:var(--btn-radius); font-weight:600; font-size:14px; font-family:var(--body-font); width:100%; border:none; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s ease; }
    .form-button:hover { background:rgba(201,169,110,0.9); }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Comprehensive automated test suite for IB Resume BA Design System mockup.
Uses Playwright to screenshot and validate every interactive element.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime

# Add local bin to path
os.environ["PATH"] = os.environ.get("PATH", "") + ":/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/.local/bin"

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

HTML_FILE = "/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html"
SCREENSHOT_DIR = "/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/screenshots"
ITERATION = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1

os.makedirs(f"{SCREENSHOT_DIR}/iter{ITERATION}", exist_ok=True)

errors = []
warnings = []
passes = []

def log_pass(test_name, detail=""):
    passes.append({"test": test_name, "detail": detail})
    print(f"  PASS: {test_name} {detail}")

def log_error(test_name, detail=""):
    errors.append({"test": test_name, "detail": detail})
    print(f"  FAIL: {test_name} {detail}")

def log_warn(test_name, detail=""):
    warnings.append({"test": test_name, "detail": detail})
    print(f"  WARN: {test_name} {detail}")

def screenshot(page, name):
    path = f"{SCREENSHOT_DIR}/iter{ITERATION}/{name}.png"
    page.screenshot(path=path, full_page=False)
    return path

def screenshot_full(page, name):
    path = f"{SCREENSHOT_DIR}/iter{ITERATION}/{name}_full.png"
    page.screenshot(path=path, full_page=True)
    return path

def run_tests():
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page.goto(f"file://{HTML_FILE}")
        page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        time.sleep(2)  # Wait for fonts to load

        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"ITERATION {ITERATION} - {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
        print(f"{'='*60}")

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 1: PAGE LOAD & STRUCTURE
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 1: Page Load & Structure ---")
        screenshot(page, "01_initial_load")

        # Check title
        title = page.title()
        if "Design System" in title or "IB Resume" in title:
            log_pass("Page title", title)
        else:
            log_error("Page title", f"Expected 'Design System', got '{title}'")

        # Check all 6 tab buttons exist
        tab_btns = page.query_selector_all(".tab-btn")
        if len(tab_btns) == 6:
            log_pass("Tab buttons count", "6 found")
        else:
            log_error("Tab buttons count", f"Expected 6, got {len(tab_btns)}")

        tab_names = [btn.inner_text() for btn in tab_btns]
        expected_tabs = ["Design Compare", "Landing", "Upload", "About You", "Target Banks", "Results"]
        for exp in expected_tabs:
            if exp in tab_names:
                log_pass(f"Tab '{exp}' exists")
            else:
                log_error(f"Tab '{exp}' missing", f"Found: {tab_names}")

        # Check 20 sections
        sections = page.query_selector_all(".dc-section")
        if len(sections) == 20:
            log_pass("Section count", "20 found")
        else:
            log_error("Section count", f"Expected 20, got {len(sections)}")

        # Check section titles
        section_titles = [
            "1. Heading Font", "2. Accent Font", "3. Body", "4. Stat Numbers",
            "5. Page Background", "6. Card", "7. Text Color", "8. Border Radius",
            "9. CTA Button", "10. Full Hero", "11. Gold Accent", "12. Bank Ticker",
            "13. Score Display", "14. Severity", "15. Category Progress",
            "16. Issue Cards", "17. Before", "18. Bank Fit", "19. Section Headers",
            "20. Top Navigation"
        ]
        for i, section in enumerate(sections):
            title_el = section.query_selector(".dc-section-title")
            if title_el:
                title_text = title_el.inner_text()
                expected_keyword = section_titles[i] if i < len(section_titles) else f"Section {i+1}"
                if expected_keyword in title_text:
                    log_pass(f"Section {i+1} title", title_text[:50])
                else:
                    log_error(f"Section {i+1} title", f"Expected '{expected_keyword}', got '{title_text[:50]}'")
            else:
                log_error(f"Section {i+1} title element", "Missing .dc-section-title")

        # Check cards per section (should be 8 each)
        for i, section in enumerate(sections):
            cards = section.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
            if len(cards) == 8:
                log_pass(f"Section {i+1} card count", "8 cards")
            else:
                log_error(f"Section {i+1} card count", f"Expected 8, got {len(cards)}")

        # Check initially selected cards (first card in each section)
        for i, section in enumerate(sections):
            cards = section.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
            if cards:
                first_card = cards[0]
                if "selected" in (first_card.get_attribute("class") or ""):
                    log_pass(f"Section {i+1} first card selected")
                else:
                    log_error(f"Section {i+1} first card NOT selected")

                # Check Current tag on first card
                tag = first_card.query_selector(".dc-tag")
                if tag:
                    tag_text = tag.inner_text()
                    if tag_text == "Current":
                        log_pass(f"Section {i+1} first card has 'Current' tag")
                    else:
                        log_error(f"Section {i+1} first card tag", f"Expected 'Current', got '{tag_text}'")

                # Check Alt tags on other cards
                for j, card in enumerate(cards[1:], 1):
                    tag = card.query_selector(".dc-tag")
                    if tag:
                        tag_text = tag.inner_text()
                        if tag_text == "Alt":
                            pass  # Don't log every single alt tag pass
                        else:
                            log_error(f"Section {i+1} card {j+1} tag", f"Expected 'Alt', got '{tag_text}'")

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 2: TAB NAVIGATION
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 2: Tab Navigation ---")

        for idx, tab_name in enumerate(expected_tabs):
            btn = tab_btns[idx]
            btn.click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(500)
            screenshot(page, f"02_tab_{tab_name.lower().replace(' ', '_')}")

            # Check active state
            classes = btn.get_attribute("class") or ""
            if "active" in classes:
                log_pass(f"Tab '{tab_name}' active class")
            else:
                log_error(f"Tab '{tab_name}' active class missing")

            # Check correct content visible
            tab_id = btn.get_attribute("data-tab")
            content = page.query_selector(f"#{tab_id}")
            if content:
                if content.is_visible():
                    log_pass(f"Tab '{tab_name}' content visible")
                else:
                    log_error(f"Tab '{tab_name}' content NOT visible")
            else:
                log_error(f"Tab '{tab_name}' content element missing")

            # Check other tabs hidden
            for j, other_btn in enumerate(tab_btns):
                if j != idx:
                    other_id = other_btn.get_attribute("data-tab")
                    other_content = page.query_selector(f"#{other_id}")
                    if other_content and other_content.is_visible():
                        log_error(f"Tab '{expected_tabs[j]}' should be hidden when '{tab_name}' is active")

        # Go back to Design Compare for card tests
        tab_btns[0].click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 3: CARD SELECTION & CURRENT TAG MOVEMENT
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 3: Card Selection & Current Tag Movement ---")

        # Test clicking each card in sections that bind to CSS variables (1-8, 11)
        test_sections = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10]  # 0-indexed (sections 1-8 and 11)

        for si in test_sections:
            section = sections[si]
            cards = section.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
            section_title = section.query_selector(".dc-section-title").inner_text()
            print(f"  Testing: {section_title}")

            for ci in range(len(cards)):
                card = cards[ci]
                card_label_el = card.query_selector(".dc-label span:first-child")
                card_label = card_label_el.inner_text() if card_label_el else f"Card {ci+1}"

                # Scroll card into view and click
                card.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                page.wait_for_timeout(100)
                card.click()
                page.wait_for_timeout(300)

                # Screenshot for first 3 cards of each section
                if ci < 3:
                    screenshot(page, f"03_s{si+1}_card{ci+1}_{card_label[:15].replace(' ','_').replace('/','_')}")

                # Check THIS card is now selected
                classes = card.get_attribute("class") or ""
                if "selected" in classes:
                    log_pass(f"S{si+1} '{card_label}' selected class")
                else:
                    log_error(f"S{si+1} '{card_label}' NOT getting selected class")

                # Check THIS card has Current tag
                tag = card.query_selector(".dc-tag")
                if tag:
                    tag_text = tag.inner_text()
                    tag_class = tag.get_attribute("class") or ""
                    if tag_text == "Current" and "dc-tag-cur" in tag_class:
                        log_pass(f"S{si+1} '{card_label}' Current tag correct")
                    else:
                        log_error(f"S{si+1} '{card_label}' tag", f"text='{tag_text}', class='{tag_class}'")

                # Check all OTHER cards in this section are deselected
                for oi, other in enumerate(cards):
                    if oi != ci:
                        other_classes = other.get_attribute("class") or ""
                        if "selected" in other_classes:
                            other_label = other.query_selector(".dc-label span:first-child")
                            ol = other_label.inner_text() if other_label else f"Card {oi+1}"
                            log_error(f"S{si+1} '{ol}' should NOT be selected when '{card_label}' clicked")
                        other_tag = other.query_selector(".dc-tag")
                        if other_tag:
                            ot = other_tag.inner_text()
                            if ot != "Alt":
                                log_error(f"S{si+1} card {oi+1} tag should be 'Alt', got '{ot}'")

            # Reset to first card
            cards[0].scroll_into_view_if_needed()
            cards[0].click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(200)

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 4: CSS VARIABLE UPDATES
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 4: CSS Variable Updates ---")

        # Test heading font change
        section1 = sections[0]
        cards1 = section1.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
        cards1[1].scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        cards1[1].click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        heading_font = page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--heading-font').trim()")
        expected_val = cards1[1].get_attribute("data-val")
        if expected_val and expected_val.replace("'", "").replace('"', '') in heading_font.replace("'", "").replace('"', ''):
            log_pass("Heading font CSS var updated", heading_font[:40])
        else:
            log_error("Heading font CSS var", f"Expected '{expected_val}', got '{heading_font}'")

        screenshot(page, "04_css_var_heading_font_changed")

        # Test background change
        section5 = sections[4]
        cards5 = section5.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
        cards5[1].scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        cards5[1].click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        bg_body = page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--bg-body').trim()")
        expected_bg = cards5[1].get_attribute("data-val")
        if expected_bg and expected_bg.lower() in bg_body.lower():
            log_pass("Background CSS var updated", bg_body)
        else:
            log_error("Background CSS var", f"Expected '{expected_bg}', got '{bg_body}'")

        screenshot(page, "04_css_var_bg_changed")

        # Test border radius change
        section8 = sections[7]
        cards8 = section8.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
        cards8[1].scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        cards8[1].click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        br = page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--border-radius').trim()")
        expected_br = cards8[1].get_attribute("data-val")
        if expected_br and expected_br in br:
            log_pass("Border radius CSS var updated", br)
        else:
            log_error("Border radius CSS var", f"Expected '{expected_br}', got '{br}'")

        screenshot(page, "04_css_var_border_radius_changed")

        # Test gold accent change
        section11 = sections[10]
        cards11 = section11.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
        cards11[1].scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        cards11[1].click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(500)

        gold = page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--accent-gold').trim()")
        expected_gold = cards11[1].get_attribute("data-val")
        if expected_gold and expected_gold.lower() in gold.lower():
            log_pass("Gold accent CSS var updated", gold)
        else:
            log_error("Gold accent CSS var", f"Expected '{expected_gold}', got '{gold}'")

        screenshot(page, "04_css_var_gold_changed")

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 5: LIVE PREVIEW PANEL
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 5: Live Preview Panel ---")

        # Scroll to top
        page.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, 0)")
        page.wait_for_timeout(300)

        live_preview = page.query_selector("#livePreview")
        if live_preview:
            log_pass("Live preview element exists")
            if live_preview.is_visible():
                log_pass("Live preview is visible")
            else:
                log_error("Live preview NOT visible")
        else:
            log_error("Live preview element MISSING")

        # Check live preview contains mini pages
        lp_html = live_preview.inner_html() if live_preview else ""
        checks = [
            ("Landing preview", "Landing Page Preview" in lp_html or "Your Resume," in lp_html),
            ("Banks preview", "Target Banks" in lp_html or "Goldman Sachs" in lp_html),
            ("Results preview", "Results" in lp_html or "85" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --heading-font", "var(--heading-font)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --accent-font", "var(--accent-font)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --mono-font", "var(--mono-font)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --accent-gold", "var(--accent-gold)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --bg-body", "var(--bg-body)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --color-green", "var(--color-green)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --color-red", "var(--color-red)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --border-radius", "var(--border-radius)" in lp_html),
            ("Uses --btn-radius", "var(--btn-radius)" in lp_html),
        ]
        for name, result in checks:
            if result:
                log_pass(f"Live preview: {name}")
            else:
                log_error(f"Live preview: {name}")

        screenshot(page, "05_live_preview")

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 6: CONTROL PANEL
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 6: Control Panel ---")

        ctrl = page.query_selector(".ctrl-panel")
        if ctrl:
            log_pass("Control panel exists")
            if ctrl.is_visible():
                log_pass("Control panel visible")
            else:
                log_error("Control panel NOT visible")
        else:
            log_error("Control panel MISSING")

        # Check dropdowns
        dropdowns = {
            "ctrl-heading-font": "Heading Font",
            "ctrl-body-font": "Body Font",
            "ctrl-mono-font": "Mono Font",
            "ctrl-accent-font": "Accent Font",
            "ctrl-border-radius": "Border Radius"
        }
        for dd_id, dd_name in dropdowns.items():
            dd = page.query_selector(f"#{dd_id}")
            if dd:
                log_pass(f"Dropdown '{dd_name}' exists")
                options = dd.query_selector_all("option")
                if len(options) >= 2:
                    log_pass(f"Dropdown '{dd_name}' has {len(options)} options")
                else:
                    log_error(f"Dropdown '{dd_name}' only {len(options)} options")
            else:
                log_error(f"Dropdown '{dd_name}' MISSING")

        # Test dropdown changes CSS var
        heading_dd = page.query_selector("#ctrl-heading-font")
        if heading_dd:
            options = heading_dd.query_selector_all("option")
            if len(options) >= 2:
                val = options[1].get_attribute("value")
                page.select_option("#ctrl-heading-font", value=val)
                page.wait_for_timeout(500)
                new_font = page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--heading-font').trim()")
                if val.replace("'", "").replace('"', '') in new_font.replace("'", "").replace('"', ''):
                    log_pass("Dropdown changes CSS var", new_font[:40])
                else:
                    log_error("Dropdown CSS var change", f"Expected val containing '{val}', got '{new_font}'")

        screenshot(page, "06_control_panel")

        # Test collapse/expand
        toggle_btn = page.query_selector(".ctrl-header button")
        if toggle_btn:
            toggle_btn.click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(300)
            ctrl_body = page.query_selector(".ctrl-body")
            if ctrl_body and not ctrl_body.is_visible():
                log_pass("Control panel collapsed")
            else:
                log_warn("Control panel collapse", "Body still visible after toggle")

            screenshot(page, "06_control_panel_collapsed")

            toggle_btn.click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(300)
            if ctrl_body and ctrl_body.is_visible():
                log_pass("Control panel expanded")
            else:
                log_warn("Control panel expand", "Body not visible after second toggle")

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 7: RESET BUTTON
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 7: Reset Button ---")

        reset_btn = page.query_selector("button.btn-reset")
        if reset_btn:
            reset_btn.click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(500)

            # Check CSS vars reset to defaults
            defaults_check = {
                "--heading-font": "Playfair Display",
                "--bg-body": "#0A0A0A",
                "--border-radius": "6px",
                "--accent-gold": "#C9A96E",
            }
            for var, expected in defaults_check.items():
                val = page.evaluate(f"getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('{var}').trim()")
                if expected.lower() in val.lower():
                    log_pass(f"Reset: {var}", val[:30])
                else:
                    log_error(f"Reset: {var}", f"Expected '{expected}', got '{val}'")

            # Check first card in each section is selected
            for i, section in enumerate(sections):
                cards = section.query_selector_all(".dc-card")
                if cards:
                    first = cards[0]
                    cls = first.get_attribute("class") or ""
                    if "selected" in cls:
                        pass  # Good
                    else:
                        log_error(f"Reset: Section {i+1} first card not re-selected")

                    tag = first.query_selector(".dc-tag")
                    if tag and tag.inner_text() == "Current":
                        pass  # Good
                    else:
                        tag_text = tag.inner_text() if tag else "no tag"
                        log_error(f"Reset: Section {i+1} first card tag", f"Got '{tag_text}'")

            screenshot(page, "07_after_reset")
            log_pass("Reset button functional")
        else:
            log_error("Reset button MISSING")

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 8: GLOBAL COLORS
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 8: Global Colors ---")

        color_pickers = page.query_selector_all("input[type='color']")
        if len(color_pickers) == 8:
            log_pass("Color pickers count", "8 found")
        else:
            log_error("Color pickers count", f"Expected 8, got {len(color_pickers)}")

        # Test a color picker changes CSS var
        if color_pickers:
            # Change the first color picker (accent gold)
            page.evaluate("""
                var picker = document.querySelector("input[type='color']");
                if (picker) {
                    picker.value = '#FF0000';
                    picker.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
                }
            """)
            page.wait_for_timeout(300)

            # Check if CSS var changed
            gold_val = page.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--accent-gold').trim()")
            if "#ff0000" in gold_val.lower() or "rgb(255, 0, 0)" in gold_val.lower():
                log_pass("Color picker updates CSS var", gold_val)
            else:
                log_warn("Color picker CSS update", f"Expected red, got '{gold_val}'")

            screenshot(page, "08_global_colors_changed")

            # Reset back
            page.evaluate("""
                var picker = document.querySelector("input[type='color']");
                if (picker) { picker.value = '#C9A96E'; picker.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); }
            """)

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 9: SAVE/EXPORT
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 9: Save/Export ---")

        # Check save button exists
        save_btns = page.query_selector_all("button.btn-reset")
        save_btn = None
        for btn in save_btns:
            if "Save" in btn.inner_text():
                save_btn = btn
                break

        if save_btn:
            log_pass("Save/Export button exists")
            # We can't easily test downloads in headless Playwright without extra config
            # But we can verify the saveTheme function exists
            has_save = page.evaluate("typeof saveTheme === 'function'")
            if has_save:
                log_pass("saveTheme function defined")
            else:
                log_error("saveTheme function MISSING")
        else:
            log_error("Save/Export button MISSING")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Comprehensive automated test suite for IB Resume BA Design System mockup.
Uses Playwright to screenshot and validate every interactive element.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime

# Add local bin to path
os.environ["PATH"] = os.environ.get("PATH", "") + ":/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/.local/bin"

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

HTML_FILE = "/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html"
SCREENSHOT_DIR = "/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/screenshots"
ITERATION = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1

os.makedirs(f"{SCREENSHOT_DIR}/iter{ITERATION}", exist_ok=True)

errors = []
warnings = []
passes = []

def log_pass(test_name, detail=""):
    passes.append({"test": test_name, "detail": detail})
    print(f"  PASS: {test_name} {detail}")

def log_error(test_name, detail=""):
    errors.append({"test": test_name, "detail": detail})
    print(f"  FAIL: {test_name} {detail}")

def log_warn(test_name, detail=""):
    warnings.append({"test": test_name, "detail": detail})
    print(f"  WARN: {test_name} {detail}")

def screenshot(page, name):
    path = f"{SCREENSHOT_DIR}/iter{ITERATION}/{name}.png"
    page.screenshot(path=path, full_page=False)
    return path

def screenshot_full(page, name):
    path = f"{SCREENSHOT_DIR}/iter{ITERATION}/{name}_full.png"
    page.screenshot(path=path, full_page=True)
    return path

def run_tests():
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page.goto(f"file://{HTML_FILE}")
        page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        time.sleep(2)  # Wait for fonts to load

        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"ITERATION {ITERATION} - {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
        print(f"{'='*60}")

        # ============================================================
        # TEST 1: PAGE LOAD & STRUCTURE
        # ============================================================
        print("\n--- TEST 1: Page Load & Structure ---")
        screenshot(page, "01_initial_load")

        # Check title
        title = page.title()
        if "Design System" in title or "IB Resume" in title:
            log_pass("Page title", title)
        else:
            log_error("Page title", f"Expected 'Design System', got '{title}'")

        # Check all 6 tab buttons exist
        tab_btns = page.query_selector_all(".tab-btn")
        if len(tab_btns) == 6:
            log_pass("Tab buttons count", "6 found")
        else:
            log_error("Tab buttons count", f"Expected 6, got {len(tab_btns)}")

        tab_names = [btn.inner_text() for btn in tab_btns]
        expected_tabs = ["Design Compare", "Landing", "Upload", "About You", "Target Banks", "Results"]
        for exp in expected_tabs:
            if exp in tab_names:
                log_pass(f"Tab '{exp}' exists")
            else:
                log_error(f"Tab '{exp}' missing", f"Found: {tab_names}")

        # Check 20 sections
        sections = page.query_selector_all(".dc-section")
        if len(sections) == 20:
            log_pass("Section count", "20 found")
        else:
            log_error("Section count", f"Expected 20, got {len(sections)}")

        # Check section titles
        section_titles = [
            "1. Heading Font", "2. Accent Font", "3. Body", "4. Stat Numbers",
            "5. Page Background", "6. Card", "7. Text Color", "8. Border Radius",
            "9. CTA Button", "10. Full Hero", "11. Gold Accent", "12. Bank Ticker",
            "13. Score Display", "14. Severity", "15. Category Progress",
            "16. Issue Cards", "17. Before", "18. Bank Fit", "19. Section Headers",
            "20. Top Navigation"
        ]
        for i, section in enumerate(sections):
            title_el = section.query_selector(".dc-section-title")
            if title_el:
                title_text = title_el.inner_text()
                expected_keyword = section_titles[i] if i < len(section_titles) else f"Section {i+1}"

# DOCX creation, editing, and analysis

## Overview

A .docx file is a ZIP archive containing XML files.

## Quick Reference

| Task | Approach |
|------|----------|
| Read/analyze content | `pandoc` or unpack for raw XML |
| Create new document | Use `docx-js` - see Creating New Documents below |
| Edit existing document | Unpack → edit XML → repack - see Editing Existing Documents below |

### Converting .doc to .docx

Legacy `.doc` files must be converted before editing:

```bash
python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to docx document.doc
```

### Reading Content

```bash
# Text extraction with tracked changes
pandoc --track-changes=all document.docx -o output.md

# Raw XML access
python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
```

### Converting to Images

```bash
python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to pdf document.docx
pdftoppm -jpeg -r 150 document.pdf page
```

### Accepting Tracked Changes

To produce a clean document with all tracked changes accepted (requires LibreOffice):

```bash
python scripts/accept_changes.py input.docx output.docx
```

---

## Creating New Documents

Generate .docx files with JavaScript, then validate. Install: `npm install -g docx`

### Setup
```javascript
const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell, ImageRun,
        Header, Footer, AlignmentType, PageOrientation, LevelFormat, ExternalHyperlink,
        InternalHyperlink, Bookmark, FootnoteReferenceRun, PositionalTab,
        PositionalTabAlignment, PositionalTabRelativeTo, PositionalTabLeader,
        TabStopType, TabStopPosition, Column, SectionType,
        TableOfContents, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
        VerticalAlign, PageNumber, PageBreak } = require('docx');

const doc = new Document({ sections: [{ children: [/* content */] }] });
Packer.toBuffer(doc).then(buffer => fs.writeFileSync("doc.docx", buffer));
```

### Validation
After creating the file, validate it. If validation fails, unpack, fix the XML, and repack.
```bash
python scripts/office/validate.py doc.docx
```

### Page Size

```javascript
// CRITICAL: docx-js defaults to A4, not US Letter
// Always set page size explicitly for consistent results
sections: [{
  properties: {
    page: {
      size: {
        width: 12240,   // 8.5 inches in DXA
        height: 15840   // 11 inches in DXA
      },
      margin: { top: 1440, right: 1440, bottom: 1440, left: 1440 } // 1 inch margins
    }
  },
  children: [/* content */]
}]
```

The interactive design system mockup was subjected to 7 full automated testing iterations using Playwright. ### Iteration 1 — 3 Errors (All Same Root Cause)

**Root Cause:** The "Global Colors" section used the same `dc-section` CSS class as the 20 design comparison sections, causing Playwright to count 21 sections instead of 20.

|---|---|---|
| 1 | Section count | Expected 20, got 21 |

| 3 | Section 21 card count | Expected 8, got 0 |

**Fix Applied:** Changed the Global Colors container class from `dc-section` to `dc-global-colors` so it's no longer counted as a design section. This also prevents the reset function from trying to reset cards inside it (which has none).

- Before: `<div class="dc-section" id="global-colors" ...>`
- After: `<div class="dc-global-colors" id="global-colors" ...>`

**Issue:** Control panel dropdowns updated CSS variables but didn't sync the card selection state (yellow border + Current tag) back to the Design Compare cards.

### Iteration 1 — 3 Errors (All Same Root Cause)

**Root Cause:** The "Global Colors" section used the same `dc-section` CSS class as the 20 design comparison sections, causing Playwright to count 21 sections instead of 20.

| # | Error | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Section count | Expected 20, got 21 |
| 2 | Section 21 title | Expected "Section 21", got "Global Colors" |
| 3 | Section 21 card count | Expected 8, got 0 |

**Fix Applied:** Changed the Global Colors container class from `dc-section` to `dc-global-colors` so it's no longer counted as a design section. This also prevents the reset function from trying to reset cards inside it (which has none).

**Lines Changed:** Line 1072 of `interactive-mockup.html`
- Before: `<div class="dc-section" id="global-colors" ...>`
- After: `<div class="dc-global-colors" id="global-colors" ...>`

**Issue:** Control panel dropdowns updated CSS variables but didn't sync the card selection state (yellow border + Current tag) back to the Design Compare cards.
